adjudication.rationale: In `app/assets/javascripts/discourse/models/store.js.es6`, `_hydrateEmbedded` changes the key match from `/(.+)_id$/` to `/(.+)_id(s?)$/` and, for the plural case (`*_ids`), it always maps IDs through `_lookupSubType`, assigns the result to `obj[self.pluralize(subType)]`, and then `delete obj[k]`. This is a global behavior change for any REST payload field ending in `_ids`, and the produced array can contain `undefined` entries if `_lookupSubType` can’t resolve an ID (there’s no filtering). The claim that this can break models relying on raw id arrays is plausible given the unconditional delete, but the diff doesn’t prove such a model exists in this PR.
